# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 charging stands for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

For most people I'd pick the **Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand**. It's WIRED's best overall pick, and 15W Qi2 is plenty for overnight charging.

## Top picks

| Need | Pick | Price | Charging speed (iPhone) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Best overall | Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand | $109 list, $98 at WIRED's link, $80 at Best Buy | 15W |
| Fastest | Nomad Stand One Max | $169 | 25W |
| Best cheap | ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station | $80 list, about $40 on Amazon when WIRED reviewed it | 15W |
| Fast, with a cooling fan | ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 (Qi2.2) | $99.99, about $82 with code PARTNER18 | 25W |
| Lay-flat design | Nimble Podium 3-in-1 | $130 | 25W |

**Belkin:** The chrome stand tilts, supports landscape for StandBy mode, and fast-charges Apple Watch Series 7 or newer. It has a 2-year warranty. WIRED notes the cable is permanently attached.

**Nomad Stand One Max:** It's the fastest and the most premium-feeling, but no power adapter is included. You'll need a 40W one, and WIRED suggests Nomad's 40W Slim Adapter at $25.

**ESR 3-in-1 (budget):** It's the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1 WIRED has found. The Apple Watch charger is a separate piece that slots into the back, and it has only a 1-year warranty.

**ESR CryoBoost:** It includes a 50W adapter and a fan that can be switched off for sleep. The 25W speed applies only to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. The iPhone Air, 16 and 16 Pro get 20W, and older models get 15W. WIRED felt the plastic build isn't premium.
- [Buy ESR CryoBoost with code PARTNER18](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand) (affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission). The code was tested in ESR's cart on 2026-10-23, but check the price at checkout.

**Nimble Podium:** Everything lies flat, so no screens light up in your bedroom, and the pads can pop up for StandBy or Nightstand mode. Apple Watch charging is slow, so it suits overnight use.

## If you travel
- **Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2):** About $80, folds slim, 15W.
- **Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable (Qi2 25W):** $129.99. Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable stand, and it includes a 45W adapter and UK/EU plugs.

## A few tips
- 25W only helps on newer iPhones (see the CryoBoost note above). WIRED says it makes little difference if you charge overnight, so the 15W models are a better value for most people.
- The AirPods case needs to support wireless charging. Check yours before buying.

**Sources and where to buy:**
- [WIRED: Best 3-in-1 Apple Wireless Chargers](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/) has shop links for the Belkin, Nomad, ESR and Nimble.
- [WIRED: Best Apple 3-in-1 Travel Chargers](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/) has shop links for the Anker, Satechi and ESR CryoBoost.
- [Macworld: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)
- [Dealectric: ESR CryoBoost listing](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand)

Prices change often, so confirm them at checkout. If you tell me which iPhone you have, I can narrow this to one pick.
